name: Local Image Generator
description: Generate images with your local Draw Things or A1111-compatible server — private, on-device, no cloud.

scripts.test: node scripts/check-no-abs-paths.mjs && node scripts/check-no-nul-bytes.mjs && vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.gate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run check:clean
scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "${OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR:?set OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_DIR}"/

author: Johannes Kaindl
